answer.rationale: Choose the best-supported sustainable SMB growth lever rather than matching the competitor's price cut. Shortened onboarding produced higher completion, faster time-to-value, and a confirmed 3% lift in 30-day retention; signup simplification also durably improved SMB activation. Promotional pricing generated acquisition and revenue gains but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, so memory_73 overstates its suitability for sustainable growth. Use a standard experiment because onboarding was not tested specifically as a response to competitive pricing and evidence extends only through 30 days.
